name: app-tcks2tractmasks
summary: Converts each .tck tract of a collection into a binary NIfTI tract mask on the grid of a reference FA image, using TractSeg's streamline-to-mask script with DIPY.
description: For every .tck file the streamlines are upsampled, mapped to a density image on the FA voxel grid, binarised and cleaned of small blobs, and saved as a mask named after the tract. Use it to obtain tract masks for overlap, ROI or fractal-dimension analyses. The FA must share the affine of the DWI the tracts were made from.

inputs.description: Tensor maps; the FA image is used as the reference grid for the masks.

outputs.description: One binary NIfTI mask per tract, named after the .tck file.
